# Is It GF?

> Is It GF? is an iOS app for people with coeliac disease and anyone eating gluten free. Scan a product barcode or photograph an ingredient list and the app says whether it contains gluten, may contain traces ("may contain" lines, regular oats), or has no gluten ingredients. It also has a restaurant card in 51 languages to show kitchen staff. Free to download; Plus removes limits. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6742151219

## Notes
- Results come from the ingredient list and allergen statements (Open Food Facts and other sources). Always check the pack you are holding; recipes change.
- The app does not give medical advice.
